policy.mainBranchSafety: Do not alter the current working Quest on main while the overhaul is in progress.
policy.productionRule: Only runtime-ready artwork belongs in assets/production.
policy.sourceRule: Component art, construction pieces and working references belong in assets/source.
policy.archiveRule: Recovered, duplicate and superseded artwork belongs in assets/archive.
policy.replacementRule: Sprite artwork must preserve Cheeky's established character while using explicit per-state anchors, display boxes and collision boxes rather than one fixed rectangle for every animation.

notes: The temporary Quest 2.0 SVG character direction was rejected after playtesting as too generic.
The established raster Cheeky sheets are active again.
Crouch remains state-specific but is now a natural moderate reduction rather than an exaggerated deep squat.
Per-state draw and hitbox metadata remains mandatory.
